# G Pen Product Guides

> Official how-to guides for G Pen devices, published by G Pen: how to charge, load, use and clean each device, its specs, and answers to common questions. Customers reach each guide by scanning the QR code on the device's packaging.

Each guide is also published in Spanish, German, Italian, French and Brazilian Portuguese, at the same path under /es/, /de/, /it/, /fr/ and /pt/ (for example https://help.gpen.com/es/hydout/).

## Guides

- [G Pen Hydout](https://help.gpen.com/hydout/): 510 Cartridge Battery. How to charge, load, use, and clean the G Pen Hydout 510 cartridge battery.
- [G Pen Dash II](https://help.gpen.com/dash-ii/): Dry Herb Vaporizer. How to charge, load, use, and clean the G Pen Dash II dry herb vaporizer.
- [G Pen 510 Original](https://help.gpen.com/510-original/): 510 Cartridge Battery. How to charge, load, use, and clean the G Pen 510 Original cartridge battery.
- [G Pen Micro II](https://help.gpen.com/micro-ii/): Concentrate Vaporizer. How to charge, load, use, and clean the G Pen Micro II concentrate vaporizer.
- [G Pen Melt](https://help.gpen.com/melt/): Hot Knife / Dab Tool. How to charge, activate, and clean the G Pen Melt hot knife dab tool.
- [G Pen Dash+](https://help.gpen.com/dash-plus/): Dry Herb Vaporizer. How to charge, load, use, and clean the G Pen Dash+ dry herb vaporizer.
- [G Pen 3-Piece Slim Grinder](https://help.gpen.com/grinder/): Dry Herb Grinder. How to open, load, grind, collect, and clean the G Pen 3-Piece Slim Grinder.

## Optional
